payload.register:
R1 (functional) CONNECT-ACTION - When the owner clicks phone-connect, the engine shall generate an ntfy topic pair, write ~/.se/<project>/phone.json with enabled=true and the generated topic, and return a QR encoding for that topic. verify: test. breaks_if_removed: no pairing gesture; the lane stays unpaired. source: UC-1.

R2 (constraint) LOCAL-ENCODE - The QR shall be encoded on our side; the engine shall NOT send the topic to any external image/QR service. verify: test (no external network call). breaks_if_removed: the topic (the credential) leaks. source: UC-2, se.adr-answer-authenticity.

R3 (functional) QR-CORRECT - The QR encoder shall turn a given input into the correct QR matrix. verify: test (known-answer vector). breaks_if_removed: an unscannable or wrong QR. source: UC-1 step 4.

R4 (constraint) INSTALL-ONE-CLICK - The QR encoder shall be vendored or hand-rolled so one-click install is preserved; any new dependency passes the ship dependency-review. verify: inspection + se.meth-dependency-ship-review. breaks_if_removed: install breaks or a bad dep ships. source: se.adr-install-over-zerodep.

R5 (constraint) ATOMIC-CONFIG-WRITE - The engine writing phone.json (a secret) is permitted (amends adr-phone-secret-machine-local); the write shall be atomic - an encode failure leaves NO partial config. verify: test (UC-1 ext 4a). breaks_if_removed: a partial/corrupt config, or the amendment unrecorded. source: UC-1 ext 4a, the config-write decision.

R6 (interface) TOOLBAR - The board shall render a top-middle toolbar with a greyed book-icon placeholder (until i6) and an active phone-connect icon; clicking phone-connect renders the QR in the details pane. verify: inspection (owner redline) + render test. breaks_if_removed: no gesture surface. source: UC-3.

R7 (constraint) BLESS-UNCHANGED - The i8 bless mechanics shall be unchanged; i8c only adds the pairing on-ramp. verify: analysis (no bless-path edits) + the i8 suite stays green. breaks_if_removed: the shipped bless regresses. source: non-goals.
payload.set_criteria: Complete: R1-R3 cover UC-1 (pairing) + the encoder, R2 the secrecy constraint, R5 the config-write amendment, R6 the toolbar/UC-3, R7 the boundary. Consistent: R2 bounds R1's encode, R4 bounds R3's encoder choice, R5 governs the write, R7 fences the bless path. Affordable: the QR encoder is the only genuinely-new build; the rest is board UI + engine wiring over i8's existing config. Bounded: excludes QR decode, external services, non-ntfy, the book, and live owner-physical pairing. No TBD.
